fixture_correction.scope: Validation assertion timing and conditions; no claim of a changed pursuit implementation.
fixture_correction.old_condition: At stage 7, require displacement from original spawn >40cm and distance to current target < initial distance +50cm.
fixture_correction.early_stage_2_condition: Require a living infected with anatomical right arm absent and left arm present, displacement from spawn >40cm, and distance to stationary target < initial distance -40cm.
fixture_correction.later_stage_7_condition: Require the same living/arm state and distance to the current moving target < initial distance +50cm (270cm for the recorded 220cm initial fixture).
fixture_correction.rationale: The rendered diagnostic showed early approach, then a near-target endpoint with only 35.786cm displacement from the original spawn. Net displacement at a later time does not measure total travel or prove a lack of earlier movement. The null-RHI endpoint differed. Separate early approach and later pursuit checks retain those two intended assertions.
fixture_correction.verification_limit: The second local rendered controlled-aim retest passed 35 assertions, with explicit living/right-arm-absent/left-arm-present values at both pursuit observations. This does not replace the failed S1 packaged result or establish the upcoming S2 package suite result.
fixture_correction.additional_controlled_aim: During stages <8, aim at pawn position +(0,1500,30); clear aim override from stage8. Both pursuit labels include alive/right/left state.
